Resolves #21928

Contact Editor Dialogs opens on Avery Chen’s editor with the studio contact list behind it. Edit the selected contact, save a draft, drag or maximize the window, or open a second editor from inside the first.

Evidence: L3 first-frame and pointer captures, real edit and focus checks in headless Chromium → L3 required.

CI jobs: +0.

Merge order. [Pages #188](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/188) supplies both landing covers. The cover pair merged first. Both explicit-theme canonical recaptures match the existing landing composition.

## AC Evidence

| AC | Evidence |
|---|---|
| AC-1 | The first frame shows Avery’s populated editor. Name has focus. |
| AC-2 | Save persists name, email and Team across reopen. The suite verifies Cancel, Escape and focus return. A non-modal replay saved a different selected contact. |
| AC-3 | The browser suite exercises nested offsets and bounds, focus return and trapping, move and resize. The capture replay exercises the drag proxy and pointer maximize. |
| AC-4 | Eight headless launches covered 1440 × 900 and 390 × 844 in all four offered themes, with no page or console errors and the editor inside the viewport. |
| AC-5 | The existing dialog card now has its scene name and caption. [Pages #188](https://github.com/neomjs/pages/pull/188) has both 1280 × 720 first-frame covers. |
| AC-6 | The desktop and phone before/after pairs, nested frame, mid-drag frame, and cold reads are below. |

## Deltas from ticket

The scene uses the existing opener, modal and animation controls. The capture manifest selects the current landing frame directly and the catalog offers a matching light cover.

## Test Evidence

All 20 targeted Dialog Chromium cases passed. Save persisted a changed name, email and selected team on reopen. Non-modal Save on a different contact and the pointer drag and maximize paths were also exercised. Direct navigation without a theme query starts in Neo Dark even when the browser prefers light.

Three settled editors advanced by 24 px on both desktop axes. On the phone, the horizontal positions were 16, 24 and 8 px and the vertical positions stepped from 270 to 294 to 318 px. Closing the top editor preserved the two earlier rectangles.

## Cold look

Two isolated readers scored the unlabelled pairs in opposite orders.

| Order | Released frame | Contact-editor frame |
|---|---:|---:|
| Contact editor first | 4/10 | 8/10 |
| Released frame first | 4/10 | 8/10 |

Both readers found that the populated first frame made the dialog’s purpose and actions immediately clear. Both flagged the small phone title-bar icons. One also noted the similar visual weight of Save and Cancel.

Frame critique: The whole editor and footer actions fit on the phone. The title-bar icons are compact, and the backdrop intentionally softens the underlying list and options while the modal owns focus. The nested frame leaves the earlier editor’s title visible. The mid-drag frame shows the live drag proxy.

Running `this.record.set({team: this.getReference('contactTeam').value})` coerces the `Record` to `"[object Object]"`, so reopening `"Edit selected contact"` after saving `"Engineering"` renders `input[name="team"]` empty (`""`).
